notes.title: Playtest Nov 2023 - Feedback Form
notes.content:
The [b]feedback form[/b] button for this playtest is enabled on the game's [b]title screen[/b] (the link can also be found in your playtest email).

Here's an extra link to this [b]feedback form[/b]: https://forms.gle/zetXBZ6CVeHgSXbY7


Please fill in this form if possible once you have finished playtesting. Your feedback is [b]essential [/b]to the ongoing development of our game!

notes.title: Playtest Nov 2023 - Small Fixes 1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players could press the stall button and accidentally sell important goods during Prelude when it should be locked.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could be game-locked in Prelude while trading with Broc during the barter tutorial.
[/list]
